items.name: utils
items.title: Utils
items.description: The cn helper for merging Tailwind classes.

items.name: folder-component
items.title: Folder Component
items.description: An animated folder whose cards fan out on hover and lift open on click, with a 3D-tilted flap. Supports color and size (sm/md/lg) props.

items.name: bounce-sidebar
items.title: Bounce Sidebar
items.description: A vertical navigation list with a bouncy, spring-animated active indicator.

items.name: family-drawer
items.title: Family Drawer
items.description: A bottom drawer with smooth, morphing transitions between stacked views, inspired by the Family app. Built on Vaul.

items.name: proximity-sidebar
items.title: Proximity Sidebar
items.description: A dash-style scroll sidebar whose items expand as the pointer approaches.

items.name: duration-picker
items.title: Duration Picker
items.description: A gooey, spring-animated picker for entering a duration in hours and minutes.

items.name: fluid-orb
items.title: Fluid Orb
items.description: An animated WebGL orb with drifting fluid shading. Supports size and color props.

items.name: scroll-progress
items.title: Scroll Progress
items.description: A scroll progress pill that tracks reading position and expands into a squircle menu of sections you can jump to.

items.name: code-block
items.title: Code Block
items.description: A clean code block that builds its entire theme from a single accent color. Pass code and a hex, it does the rest.

items.name: otp-input
items.title: OTP Input
items.description: A one-time-code input whose characters roll into place behind a caret that slides from slot to slot.

items.name: gravity-letters
items.title: Gravity Letters
items.description: A playful gravity field where letters, numbers, emoji, or any components you pass fall and pile up like real objects.

items.name: github-activity
items.title: GitHub Activity
items.description: A contribution heatmap with a footer panel that expands over the grid to rank your top repositories.

items.name: emoji-reaction
items.title: Emoji Reaction
items.description: A tapback-style reaction button that opens a bar of Apple emoji and sends copies of your pick floating up out of it.

items.name: notification-bell
items.title: Notification Bell
items.description: An iOS-style notification bell with an unread count badge.

items.name: step-player
items.title: Step Player
items.description: An iOS-style stepped progress track with a play, pause and replay control. The active step stretches into a bar that fills as it plays.

items.name: grid-reveal
items.title: Grid Reveal
items.description: A loading state for AI images that turns into the real picture when it arrives.

items.name: gooey-nav
items.title: Gooey Nav
items.description: A gooey navigation bar that separates the selected item from the group.
